method: Per-variable areas from the noise-free generator rasters of the first and last year.
rules: The lake outline is nearly constant (a small shore sector is built over, about 2 percent of the lake).
Aquatic vegetation expands in the shallow zones, replacing open water cover while the lake extent stays nearly the same.
Built-up area grows around village nuclei and an east-west corridor, outside the lake zone only.

lake_extent.label: lake extent (open water and aquatic vegetation)
